jobs_results.title: Senior Full Stack Developer
jobs_results.description:
El puesto de Senior Fullstack Developer (Desarrollador Fullstack) es un rol especializado en el campo del desarrollo de software. Este puesto se enfoca en el desarrollo de aplicaciones web que involucran tanto el lado del servidor como el lado del cliente.

Funciones:
• Desarrollo de Software tanto en Backend como en Frontend.

Requisitos:

Titulación:
• Titulación Superior en Informática o Grado Superior en Desarrollo de Aplicaciones Web o Aplicaciones Multiplataforma.

Conocimientos:
• API REST.
• Docker.
• Plataforma Cloud: Azure, AWS o GCP.
• Pruebas unitarias.

Experiencia:
• Experiencia mínima profesional de 5 años.
• Desarrollo con framework Microsoft .NET 6, ASP.NET Core 3.1 o superior.
• Angular v14.
• Desarrollo JavaScript ES6+, HTML 5 y CSS 3.
• Patrones de diseño: DDD, Clean Architecture, CQRS.
• Lenguaje SQL y diseño de base de datos relacionales (SQL Server, PostgreSQL).

Valorable:
• UI/UX.
• Uso de herramientas de testing: Postman o Selenium.
• Conocimientos de CI ... CD.
• Conocimientos de Kubernetes.
• Conocimientos de Arquitectura de microservicios.
• Conocimientos de Python.
• Trabajo en equipo en marcos de trabajo Agile y uso de herramientas de gestión

jobs_results.title: Senior Software Engineer, React Native
jobs_results.description:
Your mission

What will your contribution in this role be?

As a Senior React Native Engineer, your primary role is to lead the development, testing, and deployment of mobile applications utilizing the React Native with Expo framework. It's essential to ensure the software adheres to the best practices and stands out for its quality.

Key Accountabilities
• Develop and optimize scalable, efficient, and maintainable mobile applications using React Native.
• Write portable and reusable code primarily utilizing React Native with TypeScript
• Develop new features on a web3 based platform while enhancing existing ones.
• Ensure that data input, storage, and transmission follow ISO 27001 security guidelines.
• Collaborate closely with UX/UI Designers to transform UI and functional specifications into visually appealing, smooth, performant, and near pixel-perfect interactive interfaces.
• Work closely with backend developers to ensure secure communication between the app and backend... systems.
• Design, develop, and maintain unit and integration tests, ensuring the software's reliability and robustness.

Your profile

Minimum Experience
• 6+ years of experience in frontend development experience
• 4+ years of experience in React Native
• 2+ years of experience in Swift/Kotlin

Hard Skills
• Expert in React Native, JavaScript/Typescript
• In-depth knowledge of the mobile application life cycle, memory management, and UI components.
• Ability to code securely and efficiently in high-velocity settings.
• Proficient in Git.

Nice to Have
• Experience working with libraries like web3.js or web3.py
• Worked in payment systems
• Good knowledge of a backend framework

Soft Skills
• Strong problem-solving skills and analytical thinking.
• Desire to improve and become more knowledgeable every day
• Effective communication and collaboration within cross-functional teams.

What we offer?

Join The Team And Let's Thrive Together
• Healthy working environment: Experience a supportive atmosphere where team members collaborate and inspire each other. Our positive work environment is designed to help you thrive both technically and personally.
• Autonomy, responsibilities, and opportunities: At Gamium, we believe in empowering our employees. You'll have the freedom to take ownership of your projects, contribute your unique ideas, and grow your skill set. We value your expertise and offer ample opportunities for professional development.
• Office in sunny Barcelona: Imagine working in one of the most vibrant cities in Europe! Our headquarters are located in beautiful Barcelona, where you'll enjoy a fantastic work-life balance and plenty of leisure activities outside of work.
• Hybrid model: Balancing work-life needs, our hybrid approach requires four days in the office weekly, with the flexibility to work remotely for one day.
• Healthcare allowance: We care about your well-being. To ensure you have access to the necessary healthcare services, we provide a comprehensive healthcare allowance to support your medical needs.
• Generous leave policy: We believe in the importance of rest and rejuvenation. You'll enjoy 25 vacation days annually, plus an extra day off to celebrate your birthday. Take the time you need to recharge and return to work with renewed energy.

About Us

Gamium is a technology company that creates advanced digital identity and metaverse solutions for individuals, businesses, and developers.

We offer two products: Didit and Gamium.

DIDIT: Didit provides cutting-edge digital identity solutions for individuals and businesses, empowering them with greater convenience, security, and privacy on the internet.
• DIDIT BUSINESS: Didit’s Business solutions help companies enhance their entire customer journey, from registration to checkout, with advanced ID tools for user onboarding, identity verification, data authentication, and payments. They can be integrated as an all-in-one digital identity solution or by modules (Didit Verification, Didit Unified Access, Didit Data Transfer, and Didit Payments).
• DIDIT PERSONALDidit provides you with a free-to-use Digital Identity App that allows you to own and manage your Decentralized Identity with total convenience, security, and privacy.

GAMIUM: Gamium is a social platform that allows users to create and live immersive virtual experiences with limitless possibilities.

With Gamium, individuals can venture into a vibrant world formed by 10 Neighborhoods and over 65,000 LANDs where their wildest dreams come to life.

SOCIALS
• Website: https://didit.me/

https://www.gamium.world
• Twitter: https://twitter.com/Diditprotocol

https://twitter.com/gamiumcorp
• Telegram: https://t.me/gamiumcorp

jobs_results.title: Senior Software Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Omega CRM Consulting is looking for a Senior Software Engineer that would like to collaborate with one of the top 15 global pharmaceutical companies.

Job Description

The ITMS Strategic Marketing and Healthcare Solutions (SMHS) team is seeking an eager, motivated self-starter who wants to grow technically and is excited about proactively supporting systems in this domain. Expectation is that this individual will want to become the IT subject-matter expert (SME) for these systems, including hands-on development and configuration of these systems in order to deliver quality releases to our business partners in a timely fashion.

As a member of ITMS SMHS team, the individual will work for the DevOps Lectrona product team as a developer, being responsible for the analysis, planning, implementation, customization, enhancement, and support of the Grants Funding and Early Access systems.

Tasks & Responsibilities
• Be a developer supporting the Grants Funding and Early Access systems by... keeping them updated and compliant.
• Perform business analysis to gather requirements and other demands.
• Translate business requirements into specifications.
• Perform day to day troubleshooting and maintenance of the system.
• Apply updates to the systems as necessary.
• Create and maintain system documentation.
• Design and implement technology best practices, guidelines, and processes.
• Become a SmartSimple Cloud Configuration Specialist.
• Provide support as required to ensure the availability and performance for the solutions and their environments.
• Process/handle tickets created in the Service Management tool used at our client that are related to the Grants Funding and Early Access applications.

Skills
• Fluent English level, both written as verbal.
• Experience with HTML, CSS, JavaScript, jQuery, SQL.o Degree (completed or in progress) in Information Technology, Computer Sciences, or related field.
• Skilled IT professional with at least 3 years of experience as a developer (or similar position), preferably in global companies or providing services in similar environments.
• Experience in cloud solutions: development, configuration, and basic architecture.o Experience in development, support, and maintenance of complex systems.
• Knowledge of Agile methodologies (Scrum, DevOps desirable but not mandatory) and ITIL (change and incident management) will be a plus.o Knowledge in JIRA or similar tools.
• Knowledge in Service Now or similar tools.
• Good attention to detail.
• Positive, self-sufficient, and proactive attitude is a must.

What Do We Offer
• Permanent contract.
• Flexible Schedule. We make it easy. Balance your professional and personal life.
• Certifications plan. Improve your skills and get the official certificate from our main partners.
• Home Office. You decide and we support you.
• Flexible retribution (public transport ticket, Ticket restaurant, …).
• Health insurance.
• OMEGA in action. Our commitment to a better society is not just an intention
• Professional development: Evolve, grow and get where you want to go.

About Us

Our mission is to accelerate the business experience (BX) of its customers. In concrete terms, our 360 solutions allow business transformation and acceleration by means of technology and data applied to Customer #OmnichannelExperiences in fields such as #CustomerServices, #eCommerce, #Analytics or #Marketing. We target companies from different fields such as: #Retail, , #Manufacturing but also #Education, #NonProfit, #NGO etc. We are one of the top 3 partners of #Salesforce in Europe. Our team is composed of more than 500 people of 24 nationalities based in Spain and France, who have wide knowledge and experience that understands business processes and technology while enjoying what it does. Key to our success is the knowledge of our people. We are an innovation and Outstanding Knowledge award-winning, Salesforce Consulting Partner. Our priority is the well-being of the team. We foster a collaborative culture, involved and supported by our company values: #Talent, #flexibility#commitment and #innovation. We bring them to everything we do. #TogetherWeGrow

HP is an equal opportunity employer and is committed to considering all qualified applicants without regard to race, color, religion, sex, national origin, age, disability, or any other protected status. jobs_results.title: Software Engineer, Ingeniero de Software, Desarrollador Senior
jobs_results.description:
Posición: Staff Software Engineer

The Trade Desk is a global technology company with a mission to create a better, more open internet for everyone through principled, intelligent advertising. Handling over 1 trillion transactions per day, our platform operates at an unprecedented scale. We have also built something even stronger and more valuable: an award-winning culture based on trust, ownership, empathy, and collaboration. We value the unique experiences and perspectives that each person brings to The Trade Desk, and we are committed to fostering inclusive spaces where everyone can bring their authentic selves to work every day.

Do you have a passion for solving hard problems at scale? Are you eager to join a dynamic, globally- connected team where your contributions will make a meaningful difference in building a better media ecosystem? Come and see why Fortune magazine consistently ranks The Trade Desk among the best small- to medium-sized workplaces globally.

What we do:

Our... Staff engineers are the end-to-end owners who drive the process of designing, building, and deploying extracting insights from petabytes of data to help our clients makes data driven decisions to grow their businesses.

You will be building a forecasting solution which provides real time responses while operating on a trillion-records-a-day dataset. We often find that off-the-shelf products and approaches struggle with our volumes of data and that is the main challenge and source of fun you will have. The forecasting system our team operates is the backbone of a lot of TTD features and at the core of our business model.

Our system performs every day, 24/7, serving global traffic. We build a distributed system in a highly collaborative environment, utilizing a broad range of technologies. Our data engineers work on finding solutions to algorithmic, optimization, and scale challenges in everything we do.

What you’ll do:

You will act as a technical leader on multi-month, multi-person projects. You will work closely with many stakeholders to understand the Why behind products you will be building and use this knowledge to drive your engineering decisions and instil this understanding on the team.

You will own products end to end: design, implementation and deployment to cloud levering internal tools developed by cloud and IaaS teams at TTD.

You will serve as an example to junior engineers and help them grow faster by providing guidance in MR reviews and sharing your knowledge.

Who you are:
• You have a track record of technical leadership on multi-month, multi-engineer projects with high level of ambiguity
• You like to engage with stakeholders and help engineers in the team understand the “why” behind the work
• You are a generalist with focus on working with big datasets (tens of of Tb) using technologies like Spark and building backend applications in languages like Java, C# or Scala exposing REST or gRPC APIs
• You are able to think about performance and inspect running the production system to understand if its performance is CPU, Memory, Disk or Network bound
• You worked with SQL databases and you are a confident user of SQL language
• You have experience in deploying containerised software. Ideally you have experience with Kubernetes or you are a confident user of docker and have grasp on docker internals
• Ideally you worked with column-oriented databases, e.g. Vertica or Click House
• You worked within cloud environment
• You are familiar with Linux and able to use shell
• You can efficiently debug problems with multi-component system (e.g. Spark Job with custom code on EMR driven by Airflow did not complete, what happened?)
• You are an open person ready to share your knowledge with other team members via MR reviews or other forums
• You work with confidence and without ego. Our engineers have deep knowledge and exercise a high degree of leadership in their daily work. You have strong opinions that are weakly held, defensible ideas, and advocate for what you believe is right. You are also adept at identifying and evaluating trade-offs, willing to be proven wrong, and quick to walk through fire to support your fellow teammates.
• You value, seek out, and foster diversity. We are a global team from many diverse backgrounds, with different experiences and perspectives. To complement this team, you will welcome ideas that are different from your own and be skilled at finding and building from common ground.

What you know is less important than how well you learn and innovate. We don't need engineers who know all the answers; we need engineers who can invent the answers no one has thought of yet, to the questions yet to be asked. What and how you can contribute is what’s important to us. Our consideration is not limited by the kind of education you have or the specific technologies you have experience with.

Variety of technical challenge is one of the best things about working at The Trade Desk as an engineer, but we do not expect you to know every technology we use when you start. What we care about is that…

Posición: Lead Frontend Software Engineer (TypeScript/JavaScript, Next.js) - Digital Markets

About Gartner Digital Markets:
Gartner Digital Markets is a business unit within Gartner. Our mission is to empower organizations to accelerate growth by helping them embrace the right technology and services.

Gartner Digital Markets is the world’s largest platform for finding software and services. With more than 100 million annual visitors across four buyer destinations—Capterra, Get App, Software Advice, and UpCity—and 70 localized sites, Gartner Digital Markets helps software and service providers build their brand, capture demand, and understand their market. As the only destination for software and services driven by independent, objective research and verified customer reviews, we help connect providers with in-market buyers to fuel growth across the full funnel.

For candidates interested in taking their next career step, Gartner Digital Markets offers the best of two worlds—the... stability and resources of a large, established organization combined with the fast pace and excitement of working for a dynamic growth business. Our team is on the front lines of innovation in an industry that is always transforming, providing an incredible opportunity for you to grow and learn throughout your career.

What we’re looking for:

As a Lead Frontend Engineer, you will work with your manager, team members and stakeholders to provide technology vision, enable innovation, and understand critical trends that will create increased business value.

You will guide the team by leading technical business initiatives, applying advanced technology knowledge and skills in assessing technical requirements and proactively directing, designing and developing leading edge solutions.

The successful candidate will need to be able to communicate effectively with senior management, team members, and senior business stakeholders across the division and Gartner.

Why you’ll want to come to work:
• Architect and develop innovative applications, addressing the unique challenges of our pay-per-lead business model.
• Work in partnership with Product Owners and other Engineering leads to shape, manage and execute the product and engineering roadmaps.
• Deliver value by driving alignment on the team and developing creative solutions to business problems.
• Iteratively improve underlying technical systems and interfaces.
• Set the technical direction for your team, while empowering them to innovate and up level their skills.
• Build applications with the highest performance and scalability.
• Perform hands-on development and provide thoughtful code reviews and architectural insights.
• Ensure the platform's compliance with industry standards and best practices.
• Mentor and lead a team of engineers, contributing to a culture of innovation and excellence.

What you’ll bring to the team:

Must have:
• 7+ years of experience in implementing designs and leading the development of new software, with a strong background in Typescript, Next.

Js, React.

Js, Node.

Js and webpack, or similar programming languages.
• Successful experience leading an agile team in developing and deploying software, emphasizing planning, definition, development, testing, and production implementation.
• Experience developing high-level product specifications, while considering application performance, security and scalability.
• Expert at API integration.
• Experience creating technical roadmaps and architecture diagrams while considering product requirements and goals. Ensuring that all noted tasks are in sync with backend services and user interface changes.
• A drive to help continuously improve processes and frameworks both on the team as well as in the engineering organization.
• The ability to lead and facilitate collaboration through a remote first approach.
• Driven by curiosity and the need to learn and continue to develop.
• You enjoy a good challenge: you are not afraid to make mistakes and quickly learn from them.
• You are n’t tied to the status quo and strive to achieve new design standards.
• A passion for engineering, learning, and teamwork is a must!
• Verbal English skills (we work in English!)

Nice to have
• Strong expertise in data structures, algorithms and software design principles.
• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

Don’t meet every single requirement? We encourage you to apply anyway. You might just be the right candidate for this, or other roles.

Check out our video to learn about who we are, and what we do:

What you’ll find:
• Limitless growth and learning opportunities.
• A collaborative and positive culture - join a diverse team of professionals that are as smart and driven as you.
• A chance to make an impact - your work will contribute directly to our strategy.
• Frequent social activities such as movie night, laser tag, bowling, escape room, summer beach party, hiking & bbq, and more!
• A hybrid work environment—enjoy the flexibility of working from home and the energy of collaborating with peers in our dynamic offices.
• New offices close to Glòries and the beach in the fantastic, “innovation…

jobs_results.title: Senior Java Developer
jobs_results.description:
Why you should join dLocal?

dLocal enables the biggest companies in the world to collect payments in 40 countries in emerging markets. Global brands rely on us to increase conversion rates and simplify payment expansion effortlessly. As both a payments processor and a merchant of record where we operate, we make it possible for our merchants to make inroads into the world’s fastest-growing, emerging markets.

By joining us you will be a part of an amazing global team that makes it all happen, in a flexible, remote-first dynamic culture with travel, health, and learning benefits, among others. Being a part of dLocal means working with 800+ teammates from 25+ different nationalities and developing an international career that impacts millions of people’s daily lives. We are builders, we never run from a challenge, we are customer-centric, and if this sounds like you, we know you will thrive in our team.

What’s the opportunity?

As our Senior Java Developer you will build... high-performing, scalable, enterprise-grade applications. You will be part of a talented software team that works on mission-critical applications with big customers.

What will I be doing?
• Contribute in all phases of the development lifecycle
• Designing, developing and delivering high-volume, low-latency applications for mission-critical systems
• Write well designed, testable, efficient code
• Ensure designs are in compliance with specifications
• Support continuous improvement by investigating alternatives and technologies and presenting these for architectural review

What skills do I need?
• Proven hands-on Software Development experience
• Proven working experience in Java development
• Hands on experience in designing and developing applications using Java platforms
• Object Oriented analysis and design using common design patterns
• Profound insight of Java
• Experience in working/designing microservices
• Good knowledge of Relational Databases, SQL and ORM technologies (JPA2, Hibernate). NoSql knowledge is desirable
• Experience in Spring Framework
• Experience with test-driven development
• AWS knowledge is a plus
• Proficient understanding of code versioning tools, such as Git
• Written and spoken English
• Ability to work independently
• Be a team player

What happens after you apply?

Our Talent Acquisition team is invested in creating the best candidate experience possible, so don’t worry, you will definitely hear from us. We will review your CV and keep you posted by email at every step of the process!

Also, you can check out our webpage, Linkedin, Instagram, and Youtube for more about dLocal
